appDesc.message: A visual catalog of playful chess piece skins for lichess and chess.com — dinos, robots, pirates, 8-bit and more. Applies instantly.

popupOff.message: Skins are off — sites show their own pieces. Flip the switch to bring the fun back.

customTag.message: Made by you, with a little AI help.

gallerySub.message: every skin, on a real board

boardsSub.message: Pick the ground your armies fight on — works with every skin.

createSub.message: Design a set with Claude or ChatGPT, try it on instantly, and submit it to the public catalog — no coding needed.

step1.message: Describe your theme & copy the AI prompt

themePh.message: e.g. sushi pieces — the knight is a shrimp nigiri

copiedMsg.message: Copied! Paste it into Claude or ChatGPT, then bring back the JSON it returns.

step2.message: Paste the AI's JSON answer here

pastePh.message: Paste the whole reply — I'll find the JSON block.

errIntro.message: Almost! Fix these (you can ask the AI to correct them):

submitNote.message: Submitting opens a GitHub form — paste the same JSON there and a robot will validate it and open the pull request for you.
